topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I stepped into what I thought was a familiar corridor, but the walls seemed to have rearranged themselves overnight. There, hidden behind a tapestry that I swear wasn’t there before, I found a door. It was small and worn, as if time itself had overlooked it. I pushed it open, and the hinges whispered, as if sharing a secret. Inside, the room held nothing but an old, unlit lamp and a window that opened to a view I didn’t recognize. The air was thick with the scent of old books and lost time. I walked in, my steps soft on the floor, and the lamp suddenly glowed, casting shadows that danced and flickered, welcoming me to this unexpected space.
